observed_text:
The general maintenance and inspection material remains relevant as generic bearing education: NSK states that, to maintain the original performance of a bearing for as long as possible, proper maintenance and inspection must be performed, and that proper procedures can avoid many bearing problems and improve reliability, productivity, and operating costs of equipment containing bearings [EV-I01-003]. This is a general maintenance purpose, not a finding about any particular bearing. The supplied category 'normal' is only a caller-specified routing category in this design and does not establish that a bearing is undamaged, has remaining life, is reusable, or is safe, and it supplies no actual equipment-condition finding [EV-I01-003]. The scenario's assumed cause of 'none' is an independently specified teaching assumption, not an observation or classifier inference, and no actual device records, inspection observations, or lifetime data are supplied [EV-I01-003].

Evidence limitations:
The cited card is generic bearing education only; it has no transfer validation to CWRU artificial defects or aviation equipment.
No actual maintenance, inspection, condition, or lifetime observations are supplied; 'normal' is only a caller-specified routing category.
The card does not establish absence of damage, remaining life, reuse, safety, or maintenance release, and grants no aviation/reuse authorization.
The scenario assumption of no fault cause is a teaching assumption, not an observation or classifier inference.
The source is an undated web page accessed 2026-10-26, reviewed as model-reviewed documentary support with conditions, not expert certification or formal release.
